description: Create many DNS records on a Porkbun domain in one call — the companion to scan_dns_records for keeping a transferred domain working. Pass `records` to import an exact list (preferred when you read the zone from the old registrar's API), or omit it entirely to import whatever a live scan of the domain discovers. Idempotent: a record that already exists is reported in `skipped`, not `failed`, so this is safe to re-run and safe as a converge step. Individual failures are listed in `failures` while everything else still imports. NS and SOA entries are ignored on purpose — they describe the delegation, not the zone. Important: imported records have no effect until the domain actually points at Porkbun's nameservers, so check get_nameservers afterwards and use update_nameservers when the user is ready to cut over — when the domain is delegated elsewhere the response also says so in `warnings`. Maximum 500 records per call.

domain.description: Porkbun domain to create the records on, e.g. `example.com`

records.description: Exact records to create. Omit to import what a live scan of the domain finds.

name.description: Subdomain prefix only, or empty string for the apex. `@` and a fully-qualified name are both accepted.

ttl.description: Seconds. Raised to the API minimum if lower.

name: import_dns_records
title: Import DNS Records
